2026_03_MIN_TB.headline: Murray’s return meets Tampa Bay’s pressure problem in a blitz-heavy matchup
2026_03_MIN_TB.paragraph1: Kyler Murray returns for Minnesota after clearing concussion protocol, giving Justin Jefferson and the Vikings a chance to stress Tampa Bay beyond the short game. Baker Mayfield faces Brian Flores’ league-leading blitz frequency after pressure and turnovers helped sink the Buccaneers’ 0-2 start. Tampa Bay also has edge-health concerns with Rueben Bain Jr. missing practice, while Minnesota tackle Brian O’Neill returned to full participation. Protection decisions and turnover avoidance should shape this matchup.
2026_03_MIN_TB.model_rationale: Minnesota’s pressure structure can force hurried decisions, while Murray’s return expands the Vikings’ offensive menu; Tampa Bay needs cleaner protection and possession football to answer.
